intro.title: Let's calibrate Detoxia
intro.body: You're not taking a test. You're calibrating Detoxia to understand your patterns.
intro.privacyNote: Sensitive answers stay on this device.

questions.text: What do you want Detoxia to help you with?
Adult-only options unlock at 18+.

sections.sectionSubtitle: A rough picture of your day is enough — windows, not exact times.

sections.sectionSubtitle: Detoxia asks everyone this, whatever they came for — poor sleep and low mood often travel together. Your answers are never scored, never shared, and only decide whether to show you support options.
